sentence: The bony pelvis is made up of the two hip bones together with the sacrum and the coccyx.
note: StatPearls: bony pelvis is the sacrum and coccyx with the two hip bones; OpenStax: hip bone, sacrum and coccyx form the pelvis.

sentence: The hip bones link each lower limb to the base of the spine, and the pelvis supports the weight of the upper body and passes it on to the lower limbs.
note: OpenStax: hip bone links each lower limb to the spine's base; chapter review: pelvis supports the upper body and passes weight to the lower limbs.

sentence: The pelvic cavity inside it houses the urinary bladder, rectum and internal reproductive organs, which the pelvic girdle helps to protect.
note: StatPearls summary: pelvic cavity houses bladder, pelvic colon, internal reproductive organs, rectum; pelvic girdle serves to protect pelvic and abdominopelvic viscera.

sentence: Two hip bones, the sacrum and the coccyx
note: Bony pelvis comprises the sacrum, coccyx and two hip bones.

sentence: Formed from the ilium, ischium and pubis, which fuse during the late teenage years
note: OpenStax: each adult hip bone is formed by three bones that fuse during the late teenage years.

sentence: Pubic symphysis at the front, sacroiliac joints at the back and the sacrococcygeal joint between sacrum and coccyx
note: StatPearls: hip bones meet at the pubic symphysis, unite with the sacrum at the sacroiliac joints; coccyx attaches at the sacrococcygeal joint.

sentence: False (greater) pelvis above the pelvic brim and true (lesser) pelvis below it
note: OpenStax: false (greater) pelvis is the broad space above the brim, true (lesser) pelvis the narrower space below; StatPearls agrees.

sentence: Iliac crest, ischial spine, ischial tuberosity, obturator foramen and acetabulum
note: OpenStax describes the iliac crest, ischial spine, ischial tuberosity, obturator foramen and acetabulum of the hip bone.

sentence: Supports the upper body, passes its weight to the lower limbs and helps to protect the pelvic organs
note: Chapter review: pelvis supports upper body and passes weight to lower limbs; StatPearls: pelvic girdle serves to protect pelvic viscera.

sentence: X-ray, with CT to assess the pelvis and detect bleeding after injury
note: NHS: X-ray usually confirms hip fracture, CT occasionally used; StatPearls: CT useful for assessing the pelvis and detecting bleeding.

sentence: The hip bone, also called the coxal bone, is the single bone that makes up the pelvic girdle and links each lower limb to the base of the spine.
note: OpenStax: hip bone (coxal bone) is the single bone of the pelvic girdle and links each lower limb to the spine's base.

sentence: Each adult hip bone is formed from three bones, the ilium, ischium and pubis, which are separate in early life and fuse during the late teenage years.
note: OpenStax: three separate bones fuse in the late teenage years; StatPearls: the three bones stay separate in early life and join at the triradiate cartilage.

sentence: The ilium is the upper, fan-shaped and largest part, and its curved upper margin is the iliac crest.
note: OpenStax: ilium is the upper fan-shaped, largest portion; its curved superior margin is the iliac crest. StatPearls: ilium is the largest pelvic bone.

sentence: The ischium forms the posteroinferior part and bears the ischial tuberosity, a large roughened area that carries the weight of the body when sitting.
note: OpenStax: ischium forms the posteroinferior region; ischial tuberosity is a large roughened area that carries body weight when sitting.

sentence: The pubis forms the anterior part and curves medially to join the pubis of the opposite hip bone at the pubic symphysis.
note: OpenStax: pubis forms the anterior portion and joins the opposite pubis at a specialised joint, the pubic symphysis.

sentence: Where the three bones converge on the outer side of each hip bone they form the acetabulum, a deep cup-shaped socket that is part of the hip joint.
note: OpenStax: the three areas converge to form the deep, cup-shaped acetabulum on the lateral side of the hip bone, part of the hip joint.

sentence: The iliac crest ends in front at the anterior superior iliac spine, with a rounded anterior inferior iliac spine just below it, and curves downwards behind to end as the posterior superior iliac spine.
note: OpenStax: iliac crest ends anteriorly at the anterior superior iliac spine; anterior inferior spine lies just below; crest ends posteriorly as posterior superior iliac spine.

sentence: On the back edge of the ilium the greater sciatic notch lies above the ischial spine, a pointed projection that separates it from the lesser sciatic notch.
note: OpenStax: greater sciatic notch on the posterior margin of the ilium above the ischial spine, which separates it from the lesser sciatic notch.

sentence: The obturator foramen is a large opening in the lower front of the hip bone, bounded by the ischium and pubis.
note: OpenStax: obturator foramen is the large opening in the anteroinferior hip bone, bounded by ischium and pubis.

sentence: The ischial tuberosity gives attachment to hip and thigh muscles, including the hamstrings, and the pelvic floor muscles attach along the lower edges of the pubis.
note: StatPearls: ischial tuberosity is an attachment for hip and thigh muscles including hamstrings; pelvic floor muscles attach along the inferior pubis. OpenStax: posterior thigh muscles.

sentence: The midline sacrum and coccyx complete the bony pelvis.
note: StatPearls summary: the midline sacrum and coccyx complete the pelvis with the two hip bones.

sentence: At the front the two hip bones meet at the pubic symphysis, and at the back each hip bone unites with the sacrum at a sacroiliac joint.
note: StatPearls: hip bones meet at the pubic symphysis anteriorly and unite with the sacrum at the sacroiliac joints.

sentence: The coccyx attaches to the sacrum at the sacrococcygeal joint.
note: StatPearls summary: the coccyx attaches to the sacrum at the sacrococcygeal joint.

sentence: The anterior, posterior and interosseous sacroiliac ligaments connect the sacrum and ilium and stabilise the joint.
note: StatPearls ligaments summary: anterior, posterior and interosseous sacroiliac ligaments connect sacrum and ilium and stabilise the joint.

sentence: The sacroiliac joint is supplied by several arteries, including the iliolumbar, superior gluteal and lateral sacral arteries.
note: StatPearls summary of arterial supply: sacroiliac joint supplied by several vessels including iliolumbar, superior gluteal and lateral sacral arteries.

sentence: The sacrotuberous ligament runs from the sacrum to the ischial tuberosity, and the sacrospinous ligament is a triangular band from the ischial spine to the sacrum and coccyx.
note: StatPearls: sacrotuberous ligament runs sacrum to ischial tuberosity; sacrospinous ligament is a triangular band from ischial spine to sacrum and coccyx.

sentence: Together these two ligaments form the greater and lesser sciatic foramina, and the pudendal vessels and nerves pass between them.
note: StatPearls: the two ligaments create the greater and lesser sciatic foramina; pudendal vessels and nerves pass between them.

sentence: The pelvic brim, also called the pelvic inlet, separates the true pelvis from the false pelvis above it.
note: OpenStax: pelvic brim (pelvic inlet) defines the lesser pelvis superiorly; StatPearls: the inlet is bounded by the brim, separating true from false pelvis.

sentence: It runs from the sacral promontory across the iliopectineal line to the pubic symphysis, and it is formed by the pectineal line of the pubis, the arcuate line of the ilium and the ala of the sacrum.
note: StatPearls: brim runs from sacral promontory across iliopectineal line to pubic symphysis; formed by pectineal line, arcuate line and sacral ala.

sentence: The broad false (greater) pelvis lies above the brim, is formed by the wings of the ilium and belongs to the abdomen.
note: StatPearls: wings of the ilium above the brim form the false pelvis, part of the abdomen; OpenStax: greater pelvis is the space above the brim.

sentence: The narrower true (lesser) pelvis lies below the brim and is bounded below by the pelvic outlet, which is bounded by the coccyx, the ischial tuberosities and the pubic symphysis.
note: OpenStax: lesser pelvis lies below the brim, inferiorly defined by the pelvic outlet; StatPearls: outlet bounded by coccyx, ischial tuberosities, pubic symphysis.

sentence: The true pelvis holds the bladder, rectum and part of the descending colon, and also the uterus, fallopian tubes and ovaries in people who have them.
note: StatPearls: lower basin holds bladder, rectum and part of descending colon; in females it also contains uterus, fallopian tubes and ovaries.

sentence: OpenStax describes the adult female pelvic inlet as round or oval and the male inlet as heart-shaped.
note: OpenStax Table 8.1 compares female and male pelvis: inlet round or oval in females, heart-shaped in males.

sentence: The female sacrum is described as wider, shorter and less curved, with a sacral promontory that projects less into the pelvic cavity, which accounts for the rounder inlet.
note: OpenStax text: female sacrum wider, shorter, less curved; sacral promontory projects less, accounting for the rounder inlet.

sentence: The female lesser pelvis is described as wider and shallower and the male lesser pelvis as narrower and deeper, and the subpubic angle is larger in the female pelvis.
note: OpenStax: female lesser pelvis wider and shallower, male narrower and deeper; larger subpubic angle in the female pelvis.

sentence: The greater sciatic notch is narrower and deeper in the male hip bone than the broader notch of the female hip bone, and male pelvic bones are described as thicker and heavier.
note: OpenStax: male greater sciatic notch narrower and deeper than the broader female notch; male pelvic bones thicker and heavier.

sentence: The female pelvis is wider overall, which relates to childbirth.
note: OpenStax: the female pelvis is wider overall, which relates to childbirth.

sentence: The pelvis mainly supports the upper body and passes its weight to the lower limbs.
note: OpenStax chapter review: the pelvis mainly supports the upper body and passes its weight to the lower limbs.

sentence: StatPearls describes the bony pelvis as a junction between the forces of the spine and of the lower limbs during movement.
note: StatPearls summary: the bony pelvis is a junctional point between spine and lower-limb forces during locomotion.

sentence: Each hip bone forms a basin that supports the trunk and anchors muscles and ligaments of the lower limb.
note: StatPearls summary: the hip bone forms a basin that supports the trunk and anchors lower-limb muscles and ligaments.

sentence: The pelvic girdle also helps to protect the pelvic and abdominopelvic organs.
note: StatPearls: the pelvic girdle serves to protect the pelvic and abdominopelvic viscera.

sentence: During childbirth the pelvic outlet offers support and guidance for the foetus through the birth canal.
note: StatPearls: the pelvic outlet offers support and guidance for a foetus through the birth canal.

sentence: The internal iliac artery supplies the pelvic organs, the perineal floor and the gluteal muscles.
note: StatPearls: the internal iliac artery supplies the pelvic organs, perineal floor and gluteal muscles.

sentence: A fracture of the pubic rami, which make up the pubis at the front of the pelvis, most often follows a fall from standing, particularly in older people whose bones are weakened by osteoporosis.
note: Trust leaflets: pubic rami are the front part of the pelvis; a fall from standing is the commonest cause; osteoporosis makes bones brittle.

sentence: NHS trust leaflets describe pain that increases with movement and weight bearing, and say that a fracture of this kind is usually managed without surgery.
note: Frimley leaflet: pain generally increases on movement and weight bearing; the fracture will normally not require surgery and is conservatively managed.

sentence: In injuries that disrupt the pelvic ring, the posterior pelvic venous plexus is the main source of haemorrhage.
note: StatPearls: the posterior pelvic venous plexus is the main source of haemorrhage in pelvic ring injuries.

sentence: A hip fracture is a different injury, a break in the upper thigh bone close to the hip joint, usually caused by a fall or a blow to the side of the hip.
note: NHS and trust pages: break in the upper thigh bone near the hip joint; usually caused by a fall or a blow to the hip.

sentence: Pelvic girdle pain in pregnancy is described by NHS trusts as uncomfortable symptoms caused by stiffness of the pelvic joints, or the joints moving unevenly, at the back or front of the pelvis.
note: NHS Wales page: symptoms caused by stiffness of the pelvic joints or joints moving unevenly, at the back or front of the pelvis.

sentence: The pain may spread to the hips, groin, thighs or lower back, and people with significant symptoms are advised to speak to a midwife or GP.
note: Trust pages: pain may spread to hips, groin, thighs or lower back; sources advise seeing a midwife or GP if symptoms are significant.

sentence: For a suspected hip fracture, clinicians usually start with the symptoms, a physical examination and the history of the injury, and an X-ray usually confirms the diagnosis, with a CT scan occasionally used.
note: NHS hip fracture page: clinicians start with symptoms, examination and history; X-ray usually confirms diagnosis; CT scan occasionally used.

sentence: CT is also useful for assessing the pelvis and detecting bleeding after pelvic injury, and clinicians rule out chest and abdominal sources of bleeding before attributing it to the pelvis.
note: StatPearls pelvic fracture: CT useful for assessing the pelvis and detecting bleeding; pelvic ring injuries: rule out thoracic and abdominal sources first.

sentence: An X-ray is a quick, painless test that produces images of the inside of the body; the person needs to keep still, and more than one image may be taken from different angles.
note: Northampton General leaflet: X-ray is quick and painless; keep still; several images from different angles may be taken.
